notes.title: July Updates Online Now
notes.content:
This is a minor update, building on some of the big changes in May and June. Changes in the July release:


 Completed the mech-tube level 
 Adjusted to the invading ships health levels
 Improved mech AI
 Corrected some issues that were preventing players from being awarded achievements on the infinity challenge


Additional Update:

We are also looking at alternate pricing models, including free with no in-app purchases. In that event, we will compensate folks who purchased the game.

notes.title: Infinity Challenge Update
notes.content:
Lots of big changes, including new play mode, better gun play, Steam Achievements and Leaderboards, menu improvement, new settings and a little economic balancing. 

All New Game Mode
Along with the campaign play, have added a new modecalled called 'Infinity Mode', which pits you against infinite waves of progressively more difficult game play. You can track your progress on the leaderboards.

Exciting New Gun Play
We are testing updates that remove the cool down on your burst cannon. After this release, it will be ready to fire after the last round of the previous burst. We're also testing a new update to the FLAK cannon to make it destroy all enemy projectiles in its radius. We've also added a new crosshair that allows for better visibility while firing.

Menu Improvements
We've added a settings menu that allows you to set music volume and moved the reset button from the main screen into the new menu. We've added a confirmation dialog before resetting the game to the beginning,

Leaderboard
We've added a leaderboard for the summer infinity challenge.

Achievements & Stats
We've added 6 Steam achievements with more to come.

Economy Balancing
Since the new Infinity Challenges represent a mechanism for potentially generating large amounts of credits, we have reduced the rewards in

Upcoming Updates:

Massive Enemy Ship Animation Rework
In the first versions, enemy ship movement was done through animations. These looked okay most of the time, but were occasionally awkward and always time consuming. We are replacing these with spline based movement like those used in the infinity challenges, which gives the game and altogether smoother feeling. We will roll these out on a per-level mode.

More User Settings
We'll add sensitivity settings and other tweaks.

notes.title: May Updates
notes.content:
The May update is live now and is our first monthly update since release and comes with several improvements in the following areas:


Visual updates in the menus
Better AI and weapons for enemy mechs in The Tubes
Corrected game issues in The Tubes
Extended game play in The Tubes
Damage tuning in The Tubes


Enjoy the updates and let us know what you think about the direction of game development by leaving a review.  Updates in the works for next month include expanded game-play in the The Tubes and all new onslaught and survival levels.
